title: NASA closes the book on epic OSIRIS-REx asteroid-sampling mission: 'I am immensely proud of what we did'
caption:
NASA has officially closed the book on the OSIRIS-REx mission after a decade of deep-space exploration. The pristine samples retrieved from asteroid Bennu contain sugars and amino acids that could shed light on early solar system chemistry, while the spacecraft itself is already cruising toward asteroid Apophis.

Source: Space - NASA closes the book on epic OSIRIS-REx asteroid-sampling mission: 'I am immensely proud of what we did'
